proposal.name: Firm
proposal.description: A commercial business entity organized to provide goods or services for profit.

existing.name: Company
existing.description: A commercial business entity organized to provide goods or services for profit.

rationale: Firm and Company are near-synonymous business-entity labels with near-identical descriptions.

proposal.name: Automobile
proposal.description: A self-propelled wheeled motor vehicle used for transporting passengers on roads.

existing.name: Car
existing.description: A self-propelled wheeled motor vehicle used for transporting passengers on roads.

rationale: Automobile is a direct synonym of Car with an identical definitional scope.

proposal.name: Physician
proposal.description: A medical professional licensed to diagnose and treat illness in patients.

existing.name: Doctor
existing.description: A medical professional licensed to diagnose and treat illness in patients.

rationale: Physician and Doctor denote the same professional role with the same description.

proposal.name: Residence
proposal.description: A building or structure where a person or family lives permanently.

existing.name: Home
existing.description: A building or structure where a person or family lives permanently.

rationale: Residence and Home describe the identical dwelling concept.

proposal.name: Attorney
proposal.description: A person qualified to represent clients in legal matters and provide legal advice.

existing.name: Lawyer
existing.description: A person qualified to represent clients in legal matters and provide legal advice.

rationale: Attorney and Lawyer are the same profession, same description.

proposal.name: Purchase
proposal.description: A transaction in which money is exchanged for goods or services.

existing.name: Transaction
existing.description: A transaction in which money is exchanged for goods or services.

rationale: Purchase is a specific instance of the same transactional concept, identical description.

proposal.name: Legal Precedent
proposal.description: A prior court decision that establishes a principle or rule used to guide future case outcomes.

existing.name: Person
existing.description: An individual human being referenced in the text, distinct from organizations or objects.

rationale: Legal Precedent and Person occupy entirely unrelated conceptual domains.

proposal.name: Chemical Compound
proposal.description: A substance formed by two or more chemical elements bonded together in fixed proportions.

existing.name: Court
existing.description: A judicial body with authority to hear and decide legal cases.

rationale: Chemical Compound and Court share no semantic overlap whatsoever.

proposal.name: Software Repository
proposal.description: A version-controlled storage location for source code and its revision history.

existing.name: Statute
existing.description: A written law formally enacted by a legislative body.

rationale: Software Repository is a technical artifact, unrelated to a legislative Statute.

proposal.name: Musical Instrument
proposal.description: A device constructed or adapted to produce musical sounds when played.

existing.name: Vehicle
existing.description: A machine used for transporting people or goods on land, water, or air.

rationale: Musical Instrument and Vehicle are distinct object categories with no conceptual overlap.

proposal.name: Astronomical Object
proposal.description: A naturally occurring physical entity in space such as a star, planet, or moon.

existing.name: Organisation
existing.description: A structured group of people with a shared purpose, such as a company or institution.

rationale: Astronomical Object and Organisation share no domain overlap.

proposal.name: Culinary Dish
proposal.description: A specific food preparation served as part of a meal, typically with a name and recipe.

existing.name: Date
existing.description: A specific point in calendar time referenced in the text.

rationale: Culinary Dish and Date describe entirely unrelated concepts.

proposal.name: Legal Ruling
proposal.description: A formal decision issued by a judge or court resolving the specific legal questions in a case before it.

existing.name: Legal Precedent
existing.description: A prior court decision that establishes a principle or rule used to guide future case outcomes.

rationale: Both are court-decision concepts with high lexical/semantic overlap, but a Ruling resolves the immediate case while a Precedent is the binding principle extracted for future cases — distinct roles in legal reasoning.

proposal.name: Chemical Element
proposal.description: A pure substance consisting of only one type of atom, defined by its atomic number, that cannot be broken down into simpler substances by chemical means.

existing.name: Drug Compound
existing.description: A chemical substance, often a compound of multiple elements, formulated to produce a therapeutic or physiological effect in the body.

rationale: Both are chemistry-adjacent concepts with overlapping vocabulary, but an Element is an indivisible atomic substance while a Drug Compound is a multi-element formulation with a medical purpose — genuinely distinct.

proposal.name: Software Feature
proposal.description: A distinct piece of functionality that a software product offers to its users, described in product requirements.

existing.name: Software Bug
existing.description: An unintended flaw or defect in a software program's implementation that causes it to behave incorrectly.

rationale: Both live in the software-engineering vocabulary and often appear in the same tracker, but a Feature is an intended capability while a Bug is an implementation defect — opposite in nature despite similar descriptive prose.

proposal.name: Job Title
proposal.description: The formal name of a person's role or position within an organisation, such as a rank or occupation label.

existing.name: Job Description
existing.description: A written document detailing the duties, responsibilities, and qualifications associated with a specific role.

rationale: Job Title and Job Description share vocabulary and domain but one is a short label and the other is a detailed document — distinct artifacts, not the same concept.

proposal.name: Court Order
proposal.description: A formal directive issued by a judge that compels or forbids a specific action by a party in a case.

existing.name: Court
existing.description: A judicial body with authority to hear and decide legal cases.

rationale: Court Order and Court share the root word and legal domain, but one is an institution and the other is a specific document/directive that institution issues — distinct entities.

proposal.name: Investment Fund
proposal.description: A pooled financial vehicle that collects capital from multiple investors to purchase a portfolio of assets.

existing.name: Investment Strategy
existing.description: A planned approach or set of principles guiding decisions about how and where to allocate investment capital.

rationale: Both share 'Investment' vocabulary but a Fund is a financial vehicle/entity while a Strategy is an abstract plan — different ontological kinds.

proposal.name: Medical Diagnosis
proposal.description: The formal identification of a disease or condition made by a clinician based on a patient's symptoms and test results.

existing.name: Medical Treatment
existing.description: A course of therapeutic action, such as medication or procedure, administered to address a patient's health condition.

rationale: Diagnosis and Treatment are sequential but distinct clinical concepts — identifying a condition versus acting on it.

proposal.name: Contractual Obligation
proposal.description: A duty that a party to a contract is legally bound to perform under the terms of that agreement.

existing.name: Contract
existing.description: A legally binding agreement between two or more parties that creates mutually enforceable obligations.

rationale: A Contractual Obligation is one specific duty arising FROM a Contract, not the agreement itself — a part-of relationship, not identity.

proposal.name: Organization
proposal.description: A structured group of people with a shared purpose, such as a company or institution.

existing.name: Organisation
existing.description: A structured group of people with a shared purpose, such as a company or institution.

rationale: US/UK spelling variant of the identical concept with byte-identical description.

proposal.name: Motor Vehicle
proposal.description: A machine used for transporting people or goods on land, water, or air.

existing.name: Vehicle
existing.description: A machine used for transporting people or goods on land, water, or air.

rationale: Motor Vehicle is a near-synonym of Vehicle sharing the identical description text.

proposal.name: Corporation
proposal.description: A commercial business entity organized to provide goods or services for profit, typically with a formal legal registration.

existing.name: Company
existing.description: A commercial business entity organized to provide goods or services for profit.

rationale: Corporation is a legally-formal subtype of Company but the descriptions overlap almost entirely on the same core concept — genuine duplicate registry entry, not a distinct type.

proposal.name: Judge
proposal.description: A public official who presides over court proceedings and has authority to make legal rulings.

existing.name: Magistrate
existing.description: A public official who presides over court proceedings and has authority to make legal rulings.

rationale: Judge and Magistrate describe the same judicial role with an identical description.

proposal.name: Employer
proposal.description: An organisation or individual that hires and pays workers to perform labor in exchange for wages.

existing.name: Company
existing.description: A commercial business entity organized to provide goods or services for profit.

rationale: Employer and Company converge to the same concrete referent in most corpora (the hiring business), high overlap despite differing framing — genuine duplicate for this registry's purposes.

proposal.name: Automobile Manufacturer
proposal.description: A commercial business entity organized to provide goods or services for profit.

existing.name: Company
existing.description: A commercial business entity organized to provide goods or services for profit.

rationale: Automobile Manufacturer's description was copy-pasted from the generic Company definition — byte-identical description signals a lazy/duplicate proposal despite the more specific name.
